name: Linear functions: slope, forms, parallel and perpendicular
description: Slope from two points, slope-intercept and point-slope form, horizontal/vertical lines, parallel (same slope) and perpendicular (negative reciprocal) lines.

name: Factoring and completing the square
description: GCF, trinomials, difference of squares, sum/difference of cubes, completing the square to vertex form, solving quadratics.

name: Exponent rules and scientific notation
description: Product, quotient and power rules, negative exponents, converting to and from scientific notation, multiplying and dividing in scientific notation (coefficient between 1 and 10).

name: Logarithms: evaluate and solve
description: log_b(a) = c means b^c = a, evaluating logs mentally (including fractions and roots), common log, solving simple log equations, change of base.

name: Domain, range and interval notation
description: Reading domain and range from graphs (open/closed dots, arrows), interval notation, domain from equations (square roots, denominators), function vs relation (vertical line test).

name: Composition of functions
description: f(g(x)) and (f∘g)(x), evaluating at a number (inside out), building the composite expression, order matters.

name: Inverse functions
description: Find f⁻¹ by swapping x and y, verify with f(g(x)) = x and g(f(x)) = x, one-to-one and the horizontal line test, restricting the domain, reflection in y = x.

name: Polynomial graph behavior
description: Degree and leading coefficient from end behavior, real zeros and multiplicity (cross vs bounce), complex roots in conjugate pairs, sketching from factored form.

name: Rational functions: intercepts, asymptotes, holes
description: Factor and cancel first; holes vs vertical asymptotes; horizontal asymptote by comparing degrees; y-intercept; slant (oblique) asymptotes; writing a rational function from given features.

name: Parent functions and transformations
description: Family of functions: linear, quadratic, cubic, square root, cube root, absolute value, reciprocal, exponential, log. Shifts, reflections and stretches of y = a f(b(x - h)) + k.
